domain: organ repair, ex vivo conditioning, reperfusion and local graft therapy

counts.note: CYM5442 and SAR247799 are different exact compounds within one family. Counts are screens, not validated leads.

deduplication.method: Alias searches plus comparison with portfolio policy, prior shortlist and generated concepts.
deduplication.incidental_hits: Thiosulfate occurs as a metabolite in a SUOX discussion, not as a therapeutic kidney-preservation lead. Generic ferroptosis entries concern different exact agents/indications.

rank_recommendation.reason: AAT has the clearer published human functional claim; FXT is the strongest new organ addition but precise human methods remain unverified. No numerical rank against the wider portfolio is inferred.

candidate_updates.name: Potency-qualified alpha-1-antitrypsin ex vivo lung conditioning
candidate_updates.novelty: Refinement of existing BE-N01/AAT_EVLP; not counted as a new candidate.
candidate_updates.exactarticle: Plasma-derived AAT with Zemaira as a defined manufactured starting product; final perfusate composition and functional potency specification proposed, not yet validated.
candidate_updates.function: Existing human report: eight donor blocks split into paired lungs, 12-hour physiology. Exact numerical benefit and dose not primary-verified from full methods.
candidate_updates.treatment_window: Injured-donor conditioning/peri-reperfusion protection; durable reversal of recipient graft failure unproven.
new_evidence_delta: Patent pilot compares 10 mg/mL AAT with saline; protein/oncotic matching is unestablished.
Current label defines approximately 50 mg/mL reconstitution, mannitol/phosphate excipients, functional elastase-neutralizing potency, and a three-hour postreconstitution use interval.

Calculated contribution from a 50 mg/mL stock at 10 mg/mL final: stock fraction 20%, mannitol approximately 24–34 mM, phosphate 3–4 mM. This is a proposed formulation calculation, not the 2026 paper's recipe.
Canadian trial record last updated July 2026 lists UHN randomized Zemaira lung-transplant prevention trial as not yet recruiting; ex vivo-only route not established by record.
candidate_updates.decision: Retain leading organ proof; make matching, potency and postwashout function decisive.
candidate_updates.decidingproof: Qualified active AAT exposure compared with optimized perfusate matched for physical composition, followed by washout and recipient-blood challenge, then ex vivo-only transplant validation.
candidate_updates.go: Meaningful donor-level oxygenation/compliance benefit survives matching and washout, with interpretable recipient carryover and consistent lot potency.
candidate_updates.stop: Formulation matching explains benefit, drug-free reperfusion erases it, or molecular changes fail to translate to graft function.
candidate_updates.material_route: Manufactured starting product known; neither EVLP finished-product qualification nor actual supply secured.
candidate_updates.rights_pipeline: CSL organ-perfusion family and UHN clinical program identified; no blanket commercial-clearance claim.
candidate_updates.retrievallimits: 2026 full methods unavailable. Patent 10 mg/mL and pig 3 mg/mL doses must not be assigned to the human paper. A survival-model abstract's existence does not establish durability.

new_candidates.name: FXT-001/UAMC-3203 for graft conditioning

novelty.secondary: Defined short-exposure conditioning and active-comparator proof refinement
novelty.basis: No FXT/UAMC alias in prior corpus; existing ferroptosis screens use different products and indications.

new_candidates.exactarticle: UAMC-3203/FXT-001, original compound 39; free base CAS 2271358-64-4 versus hydrochloride CAS 2271358-65-5. Exact organ-study salt not yet reconciled. FXT-002/003 are separate candidates and not counted here.
new_candidates.function: Cell 2026 reports protection in pig liver/lung perfusion and preservation of declined human lungs under split-organ perfusion; primary abstract only.
new_candidates.effect_size: Not primary-verified; no exact numerical claim made.
new_candidates.dose_and_controls: Human dose, salt, vehicle and matching not primary-verified.
new_candidates.treatment_window: Procurement-injured graft conditioning and reperfusion-injury prevention; established clinical graft-failure reversal unproven.
new_candidates.washout_transplant: No verified postwashout or recipient transplant benefit extracted from the primary full paper.
new_candidates.counterevidence: Earlier primary multi-organ work shows context dependence, substantial tissue distribution and no injury-marker improvement in tested TNF/sepsis settings; originating-group overlap limits independent replication.
new_candidates.decision: High-priority new organ shortlist, conditional on methods audit and active-comparator proof; not S-tier.
new_candidates.decidingproof: Authenticated chemical-form/exposure bridge followed by donor-paired functional comparison against optimized perfusate and, in separate pair blocks, AAT; quantify postwashout benefit and tissue/recipient carryover.
new_candidates.go: Robust donor-level gas transfer/compliance or other organ function changes acceptance/usefulness and persists during drug-free reperfusion, with a credible exposure margin.
new_candidates.stop: Benefit is confined to markers/edema, attributable to matching artifacts, lost after washout, or coupled to harmful tissue accumulation.
new_candidates.material_route: Public 2018 synthesis, patent disclosure, Cayman free-base specification, MCE hydrochloride and Probechem listings. No received lot or clinical-grade supply established.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: US11339124B2 displays active status, university/VIB assignees; university science park lists FiriX Therapeutics developing FXT-001 for IRI. Existing program, not presumed abandoned or unencumbered.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: Public author postprint exists but exceeds web size limit; normal managed download failed. Secondary five-pair accounts and quantitative details are not treated as primary verification.

new_candidates.name: CYM5442 hydrochloride for EVLP barrier protection

novelty.basis: No CYM5442/sphingosine receptor alias in reviewed corpus; paired with SAR successor in one family.

new_candidates.function: Seven donor pairs; leak/pressure benefit without significant compliance, P/F or PVR improvement. S1PR1 protein decreased during exposure.
new_candidates.dose_and_controls: 0.05 micromolar, six-hour EVLP; water vehicle; DMEM/5% bovine albumin.
new_candidates.treatment_window: Protection against deterioration during perfusion; durable postinjury repair unproven.
new_candidates.counterevidence: Primary functional negatives and receptor downregulation; higher exposure can disrupt cell barrier.
new_candidates.decision: Mechanistic benchmark/reserve; do not promote above AAT/FXT.
new_candidates.decidingproof: Free-exposure-matched comparison with SAR247799 for sustained pulmonary barrier function through withdrawal, then useful whole-organ function if justified.
new_candidates.go: Barrier advantage persists without receptor-loss/rebound liability and produces useful organ-level function.
new_candidates.stop: Transient leak reduction lacks postwashout functional benefit or withdrawal worsens barrier integrity.
new_candidates.material_route: Current Bio-Techne listing and public batch COA; physical stock and exact received-lot activity unconfirmed.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: No commercial-clearance claim; exact current clinical program not established in this screen.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: Accepted 51-page primary manuscript read; no major text-access gap.

new_candidates.name: SAR247799 as a biased S1PR1 successor for pulmonary graft conditioning

novelty.secondary: New exact-compound EVLP hypothesis; existing S1PR1 family
novelty.basis: No SAR247799 alias in reviewed corpus; distinguish exact agent from CYM5442 and functional antagonist class.

new_candidates.exactarticle: SAR247799, CAS 1315311-14-8, defined G-protein-biased S1PR1 agonist.
new_candidates.function: Preclinical endothelial/renal protection; human T2D FMD surrogate signal. No direct lung-organ rescue evidence.
new_candidates.dose_and_controls: Human oral exposures are not a perfusate dose; proposed EVLP exposure must be measured independently.
new_candidates.treatment_window: Most IRI support is preventive; proposed treatment after an established pulmonary barrier deficit is untested.
new_candidates.washout_transplant: No verified ex vivo lung withdrawal/transplant evidence.
new_candidates.counterevidence: Original sponsor CSR reports no microvascular laser-Doppler treatment effect and termination of development. Higher human exposures can produce heart-rate/lymphocyte effects. No inferred reason for termination.
new_candidates.decision: Fund only a bounded mechanistic successor comparison before whole-organ work; not a replacement front-runner on current evidence.
new_candidates.decidingproof: SAR versus CYM5442 at matched free exposure/target engagement in injured human pulmonary microvascular endothelium, with functional permeability and recovery after withdrawal.
new_candidates.go: Sustained functional barrier protection with preserved receptor recovery and no rebound, then meaningful EVLP oxygenation/compliance benefit.
new_candidates.stop: No pulmonary translation of bias, no advantage over CYM, rebound leak or required exposure overlapping class liabilities.
new_candidates.material_route: Public exact chemical identity and research supplier listing; no authenticated lot received.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: Sanofi discontinued development per original CSR; US9782411B2 displays active status. Discontinuation does not imply available or unencumbered rights.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: Human paper and sponsor CSR accessible; exact preclinical full-text timing not comprehensively extracted, so no postinjury claim borrowed.

new_candidates.name: PTL060/thrombalexin for local graft microthrombosis

novelty.basis: No PTL060/thrombalexin aliases in reviewed corpus; different mechanism/product from prior kidney plasminogen/alteplase.

new_candidates.exactarticle: PTL060/thrombalexin, hirudin-like thrombin-binding component linked to membrane-localizing lipid tail; exact current sequence-to-material specification not fully mapped.
new_candidates.function: Pig renal hemoreperfusion flow improved; two human kidneys establish feasibility. Primate graft histology improved without survival benefit.
new_candidates.treatment_window: Graft pretreatment to prevent thrombotic injury; not established rejection reversal.
new_candidates.washout_transplant: Primate graft-local persistence demonstrated; no transplant survival benefit.
new_candidates.counterevidence: Local anticoagulant histology did not translate to survival in sensitized primate transplantation.
new_candidates.decision: Narrow reserve, below human-functional organ leads.
new_candidates.decidingproof: Clinically representative thrombotic graft injury with postwashout renal function, active free-thrombin-inhibitor and inactive anchored controls, and residual systemic anticoagulation measurement.
new_candidates.go: Durable filtration/transport benefit with a meaningful localization/safety advantage.
new_candidates.stop: Only histology or bulk flow improves, no advantage over free inhibitor, or systemic bleeding exposure persists.
new_candidates.material_route: Published construct architecture and historical custom synthesis; no authenticated ready-stock exact lot established.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: Existing academic development and patent literature; no abandoned/unencumbered claim.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: Primary abstract and indexed full text available; exact donor linkage and current construct sequence/production route remain incomplete.

new_candidates.name: MitoQ/mitoquinone for cold kidney preservation

novelty.basis: No MitoQ/mitoquinone alias in reviewed corpus; exact mitochondrial-targeted quinone distinct from other antioxidants.

new_candidates.exactarticle: MitoQ/mitoquinone; exact chemical salt and research-grade formulation must be fixed independently of commercial oral supplements.
new_candidates.function: 50-micromolar human cold-storage proof improved reperfusion flow; urine output was not significant, P=.054.
new_candidates.treatment_window: Cold preservation after ischemic exposure, before reperfusion.
new_candidates.washout_transplant: Human reperfusion surrogate; no verified human transplant efficacy.
new_candidates.counterevidence: Independent primary renal-cell work found rapid mitochondrial swelling/depolarization, including at 500 nM; different exposure conditions prevent direct therapeutic-index arithmetic.
new_candidates.decision: Hold/deprioritize until exposure-dependent injury is reconciled.
new_candidates.decidingproof: Measured tissue/free exposure with renal transport/filtration and mitochondrial integrity after cold-to-warm transition, not perfusion flow alone.
new_candidates.go: A reproducible exposure window produces durable useful renal function without delayed mitochondrial injury.
new_candidates.stop: Effective exposure overlaps mitochondrial injury or benefit disappears when measured as renal function.
new_candidates.material_route: Public compound/manufacturing precedent; oral supplement availability does not qualify perfusion material.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: Established commercial ingredient; exact preservation-use rights not comprehensively cleared.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: Full human study donor/dose subgroup allocation not extracted. Newer conference/thesis toxicity leads found but not used as peer-reviewed confirmatory evidence.

new_candidates.name: APT102/AZD3366 for reperfusion ATP/ADP clearance

novelty.secondary: Ex vivo-only pulse is a route hypothesis
novelty.basis: No APT102/AZD3366/apyrase alias in reviewed corpus.

new_candidates.exactarticle: APT102/AZD3366, optimized soluble recombinant human CD39L3 apyrase; exact source construct/lot equivalence must be verified.
new_candidates.function: Canine postreperfusion treatment improved acute lung physiology; human phase 1 establishes pharmacology, not graft efficacy.
new_candidates.treatment_window: Canine pulmonary-artery treatment seven minutes after reperfusion, acute three-hour observation; ex vivo-only regimen untested.
new_candidates.washout_transplant: No verified ex vivo pulse/washout durability.
new_candidates.counterevidence: Human higher-dose capillary bleeding time increased despite no detected thromboelastometric changes; prolonged enzyme action can matter after implantation.
new_candidates.decidingproof: Test a defined organ-restricted exposure for persistent function with measured ATP/ADP handling, residual enzyme and recipient antiplatelet effect.
new_candidates.go: Function persists after washout and residual systemic enzyme activity stays within a justified safety window.
new_candidates.stop: Only purine biomarkers improve, function requires continuing systemic antiplatelet exposure, or bleeding liability offsets graft benefit.
new_candidates.material_route: Defined clinical-development protein; no public authenticated ready-stock exact lot established.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: APT Therapeutics/AstraZeneca development documented; completed phase 1. No inference of discontinuation or available license from pipeline omission.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: Exact present manufacturing sequence and glycoform-to-clinical-material mapping not fully extracted.

new_candidates.name: M101/HEMO2life oxygen carrier for organ preservation

novelty.basis: No M101/HEMO2life/Hemarina aliases in reviewed corpus; already an established external product.

new_candidates.exactarticle: M101 extracellular marine hemoglobin formulated as HEMO2life preservation additive.
new_candidates.function: Paired first-human preservation study has secondary clinical functional signals; randomized confirmatory trial protocol available.
new_candidates.treatment_window: Preimplantation preservation, not established organ failure repair.
new_candidates.washout_transplant: Human transplant follow-up exists; initial comparison not definitive randomized superiority.
new_candidates.counterevidence: Secondary endpoints and initial open-label design constrain efficacy certainty; do not treat trial protocol as results.
new_candidates.decision: Existing comparator/product lane; no independent asset thesis advanced.
new_candidates.decidingproof: A new proposal must demonstrate a specific functional or practical advantage over the existing oxygen-carrier route.
new_candidates.go: Verifiable meaningful differentiation beyond rediscovery of M101 preservation.
new_candidates.stop: Proposal is generic use of an already commercialized preservation additive without a defensible advantage.
new_candidates.material_route: Manufacturer-defined medical-device product; physical supply and terms not secured.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: Hemarina announced CE marking in September 2022; existing manufacturer and clinical program.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: No definitive OXYOP2 results verified during this pass; no completion-to-success inference.

new_candidates.name: Mirococept/APT070 for kidney graft complement control

novelty.basis: No mirococept/APT070 aliases in reviewed corpus; existing clinical program.

new_candidates.function: Initial 10-mg clinical regimen failed to reduce delayed graft function; EMPIRIKAL-2 tests revised organ-directed exposure.
new_candidates.treatment_window: Donor-kidney pretreatment to prevent reperfusion injury.
new_candidates.washout_transplant: Clinical endpoint pathway established but prior regimen was negative.
new_candidates.counterevidence: Direct earlier clinical negative; tissue saturation hypothesis is prospective, not efficacy rescue.
new_candidates.decidingproof: Evaluate organ-level target occupancy/retention and await or distinguish from the active randomized regimen.
new_candidates.go: A new exact proposal solves a demonstrated exposure or functional gap beyond the active program.
new_candidates.stop: Repackages target rationale while ignoring prior clinical negative or current dose-finding competition.
new_candidates.material_route: Published clinical construct; independent ready-stock equivalent not established.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: EMPIRIKAL-2 2025 protocol, ISRCTN14279222, active academic clinical-development lane.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: Protocol accessed through primary indexing; no new efficacy outcomes claimed.

new_candidates.name: Sodium thiosulfate for kidney preservation

novelty.basis: Prior thiosulfate text concerns SUOX metabolites, not this exact therapeutic use; no matching proposal.

new_candidates.exactarticle: Sodium thiosulfate as a defined additive to cold organ preservation solution; not AP39 or other sulfide donors.
new_candidates.function: Preclinical preservation rationale plus a currently recruiting randomized human study; no completed human functional benefit verified.
new_candidates.washout_transplant: Active clinical trial follows recipients for a year; outcomes pending/unverified.
new_candidates.counterevidence: Accessible chemical alone does not distinguish a proposal from an active trial of the same use. Other H2S donors cannot supply exact STS efficacy.
new_candidates.decidingproof: A new proposal needs a specific exposure, selection or practical advantage beyond the recruiting STS-Transplant regimen.
new_candidates.go: Defined incremental hypothesis with direct functional evidence and credible differentiation.
new_candidates.stop: Only generic H2S biology or results from a different sulfide donor support the claim.
new_candidates.material_route: Defined manufactured chemical route; perfusion formulation and lot qualification not established by existing systemic use.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: Investigator record lists NCT06288152 actively recruiting as of this review; no FTO conclusion.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: New pig work retrieved at abstract level; no claim of transplant survival or completed human efficacy.

new_candidates.name: Inhaled sphingosine for donor-lung decontamination

novelty.basis: No sphingosine lead in prior corpus; direct lipid effect differs from S1PR1 agonist family.

new_candidates.exactarticle: Inhaled sphingosine; exact stereochemical/formulation product specification to be locked before development. Not sphingosine-1-phosphate or CYM5442.
new_candidates.function: Acute pig bronchial bacterial-burden reduction without measured short-term physiological worsening; human delivery observations remain exploratory.
new_candidates.treatment_window: Acute contamination treatment during pig EVLP; human recipient explants ventilated only.
new_candidates.washout_transplant: No transplant durability or replicated human antimicrobial efficacy.
new_candidates.counterevidence: No antibiotic comparator in the main pig experiment, brief observation and only one colonized human specimen.
new_candidates.decision: Narrow conditional reserve; not a human graft-repair front-runner.
new_candidates.decidingproof: Clinically representative colonized donor tissue with an appropriate antibiotic benchmark, viable clearance, preserved organ function and postwashout durability.
new_candidates.go: Incremental clinically useful clearance without worsening graft function or viable dissemination.
new_candidates.stop: Only tissue delivery/markers improve, no benefit beyond antibiotics, or functional injury offsets clearance.
new_candidates.material_route: Public small-lipid identity; complete inhaled product/lot characterization not completed.
new_candidates.rights_pipeline: Existing academic program; no unencumbered-rights assertion.
new_candidates.retrievallimits: Primary indexed full text supplies donor/sample accounting; no clinical recipient outcomes.

verification.rights_note: Public patent and program facts are screening inputs, not freedom-to-operate or licensing opinions.
